reuse.why: Extends the existing shared weekend helpers (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, isSkippedWeekendDay, findNextOccurrence, scan length) rather than adding parallel holiday logic at call sites.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test exists once (isWeekendOrHoliday) and the scan/shift bounds are single functions; the local WEEKEND_SHIFT_MAX_DAYS constant in schedules/app.ts was folded into the shared module.

placement.why: Date rules stay in shared/schedules.ts, the field is added to RecurConfig and to parseRecurDate's data, and callers only pass their config's holidays.

scope.why: Every edit serves the holiday feature; tests are targeted.

maintainability.why: Clean single rule, though holidays is an optional trailing argument each caller of getDateWithSkippedWeekend must remember to thread through from its own config.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend-solving sites (getNextDate, applyWeekendRule, getWeekendMovedDay, isSkippedWeekendDay users) go through the shared helpers.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday in shared/schedules.ts, used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend, isSkippedWeekendDay and findNextOccurrence; all three server call sites pass config.holidays.
